title: Quarter Roadmap Lenses: Hosted API & Model Catalog — Decision Log
creator: Maya Liu
description: This ticket captures the decisions, trade-offs, and commitment lanes for the upcoming quarter's hosted API + model catalog roadmap. We are introducing a 'lenses' approach (Cost, Latency, Quality, Reliability) to explicitly gate model onboarding and endpoint promotions. The goal is to produce a compact, operable set of commitments (Core, Experimental, Contingency) tied to OKRs and measurable signals so engineering and infra can size Dedicated capacity and we can schedule canaries with clear rollback rules.
decision_log: 2026-03-10: Adopted 'three-lane' commitment model: Core (SLA-backed), Experimental (fast iteration), Contingency (fallback models). Decided by PM+Infra sync.
2026-03-11: Lenses finalized: Cost-per-token threshold, p95 latency target, embedding quality baseline (cosine >= 0.78 on reference set), and platform error rate < 0.5%. Refs: evaluation harness v2.
2026-03-11: Canaries to use region-based rollouts (US-EAST then EU-WEST). Canary window 72h, auto-metric-checks to gate full rollout; manual rollback for quality regressions agreed.
2026-03-12: Deferred decision on quantization profile for 'Experimental' lane — placed dependency on ENG-1842 kernel-selection tests.
2026-03-12: Agreed to publish a minimal 'commitment matrix' to Console: per-model lane, SLOs, cost-estimate buckets, and test prompts for regression checks.
review_feedback: Design (Asha Patel): request clearer Console UX copy for commitment lanes; suggested microcopy for canary state explanations.
Engineering (Derrick Stone): flagged autoscaling interaction with Dedicated pools; recommended sim run before formal commit.
Security (Leila Ahmed): noted that Private deployments need a separate opt-in cadence for model rotation; added to risks.
Trust & Safety (Nikhil Rao): requested additional evals on hallucination for retrieval-augmented models in Experimental lane.
milestones: M1: Finalize commitment matrix and publish draft to Console — 2026-03-18
M2: Run Dedicated capacity simulation with proposed lanes — 2026-03-25
M3: Complete EV tests for quantization profiles (ENG-1842) — 2026-03-29
M4: Canary schedule and rollback handbook published — 2026-04-05
M5: OKR alignment review and exec sync — 2026-04-10
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Commitment matrix visible in Console with per-model lane and linked SLOs
AC2: Simulation report showing Dedicated capacity delta for Core vs. Experimental traffic
AC3: Eval harness runs pass quality thresholds for models assigned to Core lane
AC4: Canary procedure documented with automated gating metrics and manual rollback steps
metrics: Primary: p95 generation latency (ms) by model and lane
Cost: projected cost-per-1M tokens by lane
Quality: embedding recall@10 and cosine baseline on reference prompts
Reliability: platform error rate and canary pass rate
next_steps: Publish the draft commitment matrix and solicit feedback from Platform and Sales by 2026-03-16
Schedule a 60-minute cross-functional simulation review (Infra, ML Eng, PM, Sales Ops) for 2026-03-22
Trigger ENG-1842 test runs with Experimental quantization candidates and capture kernel perf artifacts
Design to produce microcopy for commitment lane states and canary UX badges by 2026-03-17
